theorem_title: Reduced journeys preserve the movement constraints
formal_statement: theorem AngelDevil.reducedJourney_is_journey (p : Nat) (h : List AngelDevil.Point) (hj : AngelDevil.Journey p h) : AngelDevil.Journey p (AngelDevil.reducedJourney p h) := by sorry
natural_language_statement: For any nonnegative integer power and any finite journey starting at the origin with each coordinate changing by at most that power per step, the earliest-predecessor reduction is again a journey with the same movement constraint. This states the structural validity of the reduction; the separate assertion about avoiding squares eaten by the transformed Devil is not included.
source: Mathe, The Angel of power 2 wins (2007), https://doi.org/10.1017/S0963548306008303, author manuscript p. 3, equation (1) and the paragraph immediately following it.
